messages:
olivia: heads-up — onboarding Mariner customer LoRA merge onto redwood/mariner-13b. ran a quick int4 smoketest and seeing small but consistent regressions on the txn QA pack, plus a few prompts with weird tokenization/truncation. anyone seen this pattern after adapter stitch + int4 quant?

sam: did you use tokenizer v2 for the merge? last time the adapter stitch shifted special token ids and broke some prefix handling.

ciara: i kicked off the quickpack earlier today, attaching eval summary below. short version: drop ~2% exact_match on txn-parsing, some truncation on long prompts.

eval-bot: run 1742506900 mariner-merge-quickpack completed.
```
summary:
  exact_match: base=0.824 -> merged_int4=0.807 (-0.017)
  bleu: base=45.1 -> merged_int4=43.8
  latency_p50: base=110ms -> merged_int4=98ms
  sample_failures: ["Confirm the transfer -> \"Confirm the tr\" (truncated)", "Invoice parse -> extra tokens inserted"]
```

raj: sounds like a tokenizer + kv-cache alignment issue. two likely roots: (1) stitch changed special token indices or offsets; (2) int4 quantization altered kv-cache layout causing early stop for some sequence lengths. suggested triage: run token_check, re-stitch with --preserve-offsets, and run the quickpack with exact same tokenization mapping.

ciara: ran token_check against base model before quant. output: 
```
tokens_checked: 12000
mismatches: 0
special_token_shifts: 3 (pad,bos,eos)
notes: shifts are non-zero offsets compared to base tokenizer mapping
```

sam: if special tokens shifted, remap them before quant/merge. quick fix: `python tools/token_patch.py --model redwood/mariner-13b --map-bos=<id> --map-eos=<id>` then re-stitch. longer-term we should make stitch preserve those indices by default.

ciara: i'll re-stitch with `adapter-stitch --input mariner-lora-v3 --base redwood/mariner-13b --preserve-offsets --out mariner-merged-preserve` and then run the quickpack. planning to run in ~20–30m. will post results. :thumbsup:

sam: also try a quick sanity eval with `--max-seq 512` to reproduce truncation deterministically. if kv alignment is off it often shows up at specific seq lengths.

deploy-bot: queued quickpack run qk-992 for mariner-merged-preserve at 1742507700 (status: scheduled).
